title: Urgency without Direction is a problem with AI. Use it with purpose.

chapters.title: Using AI with purpose to solve real problems
Adoption challenges with rapid feature changes
Overwhelm with new Copilot features and agents
Starting simple with Copilot and iterating

features.name: Copilot instructions
features.description: New Copilot instructions capabilities that came out, which speakers noted caused overwhelm and pressure to learn how to create them.
caveats: can cause overwhelm for new users

features.name: Copilot skills
features.description: Skills capability within Copilot that was introduced alongside instructions and agents, initially creating confusion about usage.
caveats: can cause overwhelm for new users

features.name: Copilot agents
features.description: Agent capability within Copilot that was released alongside instructions and skills, contributing to adoption complexity.
caveats: can cause overwhelm for new users

features.name: Copilot prompt creation
features.description: Ability to create custom prompts within Copilot for specific use cases, which users can learn progressively by starting simple.

quotes.text: to help solve problems for customers and other people instead of feeling the pressure to use it, use it and apply it
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the core principle that AI should be used with purpose to solve real problems, not just adopted for adoption's sake.

quotes.text: the rate of change is so fast that sometimes it's difficult to adopt it
quotes.why_it_matters: Identifies a major barrier to Copilot and AI feature adoption - users struggle to keep up with the pace of new capabilities.

quotes.text: when these whole new Copilot instructions came out and skills and agents, I was a little overwhelmed
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows that even knowledgeable users experience overwhelm when multiple new Copilot capabilities are released simultaneously.

quotes.text: I'll just create something very simple." I had I had Copilot help me do it.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows the practical way to start: build something simple and let Copilot help create it.

quotes.text: And now I create these things all the time. I'm creating prompts
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows how iterative, simple-first approach leads to ongoing confidence and capability building with Copilot.
